gear.d: A tall violet witch hat with a gold buckle and a star charm on its tip. XP +10%, light +30. Skill (Q): Hex slows and hurts monsters around you.
Hot-pink headphones with neon rings. Speed +5%, cooldowns -5%. Skill (Q): Drop the Beat, a 4s sprint.
A black-lacquer samurai helmet with red guards and a gold crest. Damage taken -8%, damage +8%. Skill (Q): Battle Cry, +50% damage for 6s.
A glass space bubble with a collar ring and a blinking antenna. Light +120, jump +8%. Skill (Q): Low Gravity, floaty jumps for 6s.
Laced red lamellar armour with shoulder guards and plated tassets. Damage taken -18%, damage +10%. Skill (R): Iaido, a dashing slash.
A green flight jacket with an orange lining and a star patch. Speed +8%, damage taken -8%. Skill (R): Hype, +40% speed for 5s.
A white space suit with a chest control panel and a life-support pack. Damage taken -15%, regenerate, light +50. Skill (R): Oxygen Boost, heal 35 HP.
Chunky padded space boots. Jump +22%, speed +4%. Skill (Shift): Moon Leap, a huge floaty leap.
Black high-tops with glowing cyan soles and pink laces. Speed +16%, jump +6%. Skill (Shift): Neon Dash.
Gold plate gauntlets set with a ruby. Break power +1, damage +10%, gems +10%. Skill (F): Royal Decree, double gems for 6s.

A deep black hood over a plain, featureless white mask with hollow, faintly glowing eyes. A strong dark aura swirls around you. Crit +12%, damage +12%, speed +8%. Skill (Q): Vanish, a living shadow for 5s (untouchable, +40% speed).

A black suit under a ragged shadow cloak and capelet, clasped with a violet gem. A strong dark aura swirls around you. Damage taken -25%, damage +15%, +50 HP, regenerate. Skill (R): Legion of Shadows, a dark nova that crushes and drags every monster nearby.

A pastel-pink bunny hood with floppy ears, fluffy white trim, a cyan ribbon bow and a bubble charm. A cute bubble aura floats around you: iridescent bubbles rise, wobble and pop into sparkles and hearts. Luck +15%, speed +8%, jump +8%, regenerate. Skill (Q): Bubble Shield, float inside a shimmering bubble for 5s (untouchable, gentle healing).

A frilly pink dress with a big cyan bow, bubble buttons, puff sleeves, a tiered pastel skirt and two little bubble wings. A cute bubble aura floats around you. Damage taken -22%, +60 HP, damage +10%, gems +10%, regenerate. Skill (R): Bubble Burst, bubbles trap every monster nearby, then pop for big damage; heals 18%.

A floating golden halo over a laurel circlet with a sun gem. A holy aura of drifting feathers, a sun halo and a column of light surrounds you. Crit +15%, damage +14%, XP +10%, light +120. Skill (Q): Divine Light, a pillar of light smites monsters around you and heals you 20%.

A white-and-gold robe with a sun medallion, feathered pauldrons and small white wings. A holy aura surrounds you. Damage taken -28%, +80 HP, damage +15%, regenerate. Skill (R): Judgement, holy rays strike up to 8 monsters at once.

A crimson scaled helm with sweeping bone horns, a gold rim and an ember stone. A blazing aura of flames, embers and a burning ring surrounds you. Damage +18%, crit +10%, crit damage +25%, damage taken -6%. Skill (Q): Dragon Roar, a blast of fire burns and stuns monsters in front of you.

Crimson scale armour with a gold-trimmed breastplate, a glowing ember gem, spiked pauldrons and dragon wings. A blazing aura surrounds you. Damage taken -30%, damage +18%, +70 HP. Skill (R): Dragonfire Nova, a ring of fire burns every monster within 8 tiles.

Fox ears and a white kitsune mask worn on the side, painted in red, with a golden bell. Sakura petals and blue foxfire wisps swirl around you. Crit +12%, speed +10%, luck +8%. Skill (Q): Foxfire, five blue wisps seek out the nearest monsters.

A white kimono with a red collar, a dark obi, a red hakama and three fluffy fox tails that sway as you move. Sakura petals swirl around you. Damage taken -18%, speed +10%, damage +10%. Skill (R): Petal Step, dash through monsters in a storm of petals.

A silver tiara of ice crystals with a frost gem and snowflake charm. Snowflakes fall and ice shards rise around you. XP +12%, cooldowns -10%, light +80. Skill (Q): Glacial Gaze, monsters around you freeze for 3s.

An ice-blue gown with a snowflake brooch, crystal epaulettes, an icicle hem and a translucent frost mantle. A wintry aura surrounds you. Damage taken -20%, +50 HP, regenerate. Skill (R): Blizzard, a snowstorm around you slows and hurts monsters for 5s.

A black techwear hood with neon piping, LED ears and a glowing visor. Neon pixels and glitch light rise around you. Cooldowns -12%, speed +8%, crit +8%. Skill (Q): Glitch Step, blink up to 6 tiles ahead, untouchable for a moment.

A black techwear jacket with neon seams, a glowing zip, a chest LED panel, armoured shoulders and a tech pack. A neon aura surrounds you. Damage taken -16%, speed +12%, damage +8%. Skill (R): EMP Pulse, stuns every monster around you.

charms.d: A cream bunny with a two-leaf sprout between its ears. It hops after you and flops its ears when it naps. A companion.
A floating bubble jelly with swaying ribbon tentacles that bobs along beside you. A companion.
A round baby dragon that flies beside you, flaps its little wings and puffs embers from its flame-tipped tail. A companion.
A ring of golden runes turns slowly above your head.
Cherry petals circle you and trail behind as you run.
A little star orbits you, leaving a sparkling tail.
